playlistContent.title: MUSIC | LUNCHTIME CONCERT #5
playlistContent.description:
MUSIC | YEARS 7-9 | AUDIENCE & LIVE STREAM

Thursday 29 October @ 12:45PM (Audience and Live Stream)

Recital Room | Victorian College of the Arts Secondary School

57 Miles Street, Southbank Victoria

Semi-formal, semi-relaxed, our Lunchtime Concert series provides a valuable opportunity for students to perform in a chamber music setting.

Chamber music (small ensembles) is a cornerstone of the VCASS training program and we are continually delighted by the quality of the repertoire prepared by our students for this series.

Enquiries | enquiries@vcass.vic.edu.au

playlistContent.title: DANCE | YEAR 11 CREATIVE PROJECT
playlistContent.description:
DANCE | YEAR 11 | AUDIENCE & LIVE STREAM

Tuesday 1 December @ 6.00PM

Studio Theatre | Victorian College of the Arts Secondary School

57 Miles Street, Southbank Victoria

Our Year 11 Dance students have spent many months planning this season and have relished the opportunity to develop their own creative visions in diverse styles of dance. They have embraced the chance to explore varied musical sources, personal movement languages and inventive group structures.

They have taken risks, experimented and rigorously explored their own ideas and movement vocabularies to create these exciting pieces. They have progressed their directorial and choreographic abilities over the rehearsal period and their support and encouragement of one another is key to the success of this project.

Enquiries | enquiries@vcass.vic.edu.au

playlistContent.title: DANCE | YEAR 10 CREATIVE PROJECT
playlistContent.description:
DANCE | YEAR 10 | AUDIENCE & LIVE STREAM

Tuesday 8 December @ 6.00PM

Studio 1 | Victorian College of the Arts Secondary School

57 Miles Street, Southbank Victoria

This performance sees the culmination of months of work and planning. Our Year 10 Creative Project showcases the versatility of our students not only as dancers but also as young choreographers, directors and administrators. Working with their peers as well as Year 7, 8 and 9 dancers, they have brought their individual style and love of performing to the stage for this exciting show.
